title: USC OIS: Important Update About CPT Requirements (curated summary)
text:
USC CPT policy announcement, published August 25, 2026: OIS describes SEVP's August 24 clarification that practical training must be a required component of the established curriculum for everyone in the program, including domestic students.
USC states that, effective August 24, CPT authorization is limited to practical training required for graduation. An elective that is not mandatory for all students does not establish eligibility. The university and academic departments will confirm the documentation needed for proposed training; processing may be delayed during the adjustment.
The announcement also says Fall 2026 authorizations issued before August 24 would remain in place. This is a dated transition statement, not a general approval for later requests. Read the current CPT procedures as well as this announcement, and ask OIS about a particular program or previously issued authorization.
